title: First District · Engineering cultures
intent: Six original groups give the district a deeper identity through materials, silhouettes and real work specialties. They are helpful working cultures, not enemies, demographics, provider brands or permission levels.

authorship.basis: New names and designs authored for Agent Bus from broad institutional, inventive fabrication, mobile relay, civic knowledge, recovery and experience-lab themes.
constraints: No franchise names, logos, near-copy silhouettes or story references.
No crime, weapons, intimidation, harmful stereotypes or age-exclusive motifs.
No productivity multipliers, cosmetic success rewards or fictional quota/resource claims.
Names are original design proposals; no assertion of worldwide trademark exclusivity.

contract.capabilities: Faction identity describes a specialty. The real worker/provider/run determines capability and authorization.
contract.truth: A label never proves work happened. Activity requires a report/observation; completion requires the actual candidate-bound result.
contract.implementationStatus: Existing bus/Test paths are implemented baseline. District V2 module references mean source is present; root owns final runtime/browser/provider qualification. Faction-specific behavior and advanced facilities remain future design.
contract.selection: Do not auto-assign a faction to a provider or alter permissions. The same Codex/Claude worker may perform any authorized supported specialty.
contract.firstDistrict: Use a compact readable legend and at most a small badge/material trim. Preserve the approved map and all existing facility identities.
contract.accessibility: Every glyph/accent is paired with a plain specialty label. Faction names are optional flavor; the action says what it actually does.

factions.name: Aster Measure
factions.silhouette: Compact stepped instrument towers, square apertures, symmetric equipment housings and visible measuring rails; precise rather than imposing.

display.firstDistrictAccent: One cyan outlined square and thin material seam at Test; no new building.
display.workerTreatment: Neutral engineer sprite plus a small labeled Checks badge.

implemented.capability: Run Agent Bus's six real smoke checks
implemented.limit: Tests Agent Bus itself; source/provenance/cancellation guards must still pass. Faction does not grant a pass.
implemented.signal: Six named observed results, process exits and matching source hashes.

implemented.capability: Check and snapshot the generated project
implemented.limit: Five fixed source/artifact checks are not full behavioral/browser testing.
implemented.signal: Named check results plus exact artifact/source manifest.

future: User-chosen project test recipes with explicit safe command contracts
Inspectable test coverage and regression history
factions.noClaim: A bright badge, an online heartbeat or model prose cannot satisfy a check.

factions.name: Copper Patch
factions.silhouette: Offset work bays, modular brackets, visible tool drawers and purposeful repair seams; inventive and well maintained.
workerTraits: Utility aprons over the shared suit

display.firstDistrictAccent: Existing amber workshop lighting and one restrained copper tab.
display.workerTreatment: Neutral engineer sprite plus a labeled Build badge; no raster recoloring required.

implemented.capability: Scoped read/write work in a generated project
implemented.limit: Only managed project files; no general shell or external workspace editing. A file change is not a successful build.
implemented.signal: Actual file-write event and changed content hash.

implemented.capability: Create an immutable public artifact from checked bytes
implemented.limit: The current recipe copies the bounded starter project; arbitrary framework builds are future work.
implemented.signal: Artifact directory, manifest and candidate hash.

future: Project-specific real build recipes and artifact formats
factions.noClaim: A workshop animation or a copied file cannot imply application behavior was verified.

factions.name: Farline Relay
factions.silhouette: Low portable relay kits, folding supports, compact antennas and clearly labeled cargo; mobile without a vehicle or combat motif.

display.firstDistrictAccent: A blue labeled Relay badge near the existing central communications tower.
display.workerTreatment: Neutral engineer sprite with a small Relay tag; provider/account identity remains separate.

implemented.capability: Exchange messages and files between registered agents
implemented.limit: Inbox delivery is polling; a message delivered/read is not an executed task.
implemented.signal: Message/read receipt and file byte/hash record.

implemented.capability: Reach the bus from local VMs
implemented.limit: VM bus connectivity does not make a remote map worker executable. Current District bridge is loopback only.
implemented.signal: Authenticated hub connection and real bus operation result.

future: Explicitly authorized remote task execution with host identity
Offline transfer reconciliation and resumable artifact delivery
factions.noClaim: A connected antenna or heartbeat means reachable, not productive, authenticated to a model or quota available.

factions.name: Open Lantern
factions.silhouette: Welcoming open bays, stepped shelves, large shared tables and one modest observatory instrument; knowledge is shared rather than mysterious.
workerTraits: Careful distinction between findings and guesses

display.firstDistrictAccent: A violet labeled Research badge; keep the approved cyan Research building/sign intact.
display.workerTreatment: Neutral engineer sprite with a Research label; no implied personality, age or demographic assignment.

implemented.capability: Show an agent's reported research phase immediately
implemented.limit: This is Agent-reported activity. It does not establish a research artifact or grant execution authority.
implemented.signal: Correlated report identity, text, freshness and Agent-reported basis label.

implemented.capability: Read bounded files in the managed project
implemented.limit: No arbitrary repository, network search or external content permission is added by the faction.
implemented.signal: Observed scoped tool/file result when available; reported intent stays labeled reported.

future: User-approved research tools with explicit scope and citation checks
factions.noClaim: Research location and a thoughtful message are not evidence that an external source was read or verified.

factions.name: Harbor Reset
factions.silhouette: Stable low archive stacks, protected recessed handles and paired before/after storage bays; reliable and approachable rather than militarized.

display.firstDistrictAccent: A small labeled Recovery tab in checkpoint controls; do not recolor Review's outcome states.
display.workerTreatment: Neutral engineer sprite with a Recovery tag only when correlated recovery work is reported/observed.

implemented.capability: Create, inspect and restore managed project checkpoints
implemented.limit: Only owned workspace files. Restore archives current state first; the user/runtime command owns authority.
implemented.signal: Immutable checkpoint ID, stored bytes/hashes, actual diff and restore result.

implemented.capability: Cancel owned Test processes and record interrupted jobs
implemented.limit: A cancellation request is not confirmed exit. It does not promise rollback of arbitrary external work.
implemented.signal: Observed process termination or explicit unconfirmed/interrupted status.

future: Workspace-specific recovery policies with visible manifests
factions.noClaim: A checkpoint icon cannot replace saved bytes; a restore animation cannot prove the expected files returned.

factions.name: Prism Yard
factions.specialty: See and refine the built result
factions.silhouette: A compact freestanding rectangular preview arch with recessed display aperture, exposed service conduit and one small console; no franchise gate motifs.

display.firstDistrictAccent: The reusable GPU-rendered portal at the existing landing pad, plus a small labeled Preview badge.
display.workerTreatment: Neutral engineer sprite; selected element and candidate identity live in the real preview UI.

implemented.limit: This static facility artwork is not a software preview or acceptance evidence.
implemented.signal: Blender render log confirms NVIDIA RTX3070Ti OptiX path tracing; editable mesh/source and PNG hashes retained.

implemented.capability: Preview exact built artifact and request an element change
implemented.limit: Current candidate/run/nonce must match. A page visible is not functional or human UX acceptance.
implemented.signal: Actual loopback preview identity, selected element, submitted instruction and subsequent real edit/check/candidate.

future: Additional project previews with meaningful behavioral checks
Recorded before/after review tied to exact candidates
factions.noClaim: Neither a glowing portal nor the faction badge certifies a candidate. The real browser and evidence remain inspectable.

integration.workerBinding: Optional display metadata only. Do not create duplicate executable workers, remap provider identity, dispatch commands or infer activity from a faction choice.
integration.badgeRule: One small glyph/accent and a text specialty label; details panel can reveal the group name and material description.
integration.warning: Faction green is an identity accent only and must not be rendered as a passed check badge. Existing success/error/evidence-basis styles remain authoritative.
integration.phaseVersusFaction: Facility phase stays tied to real activity. Faction accent belongs on a separate small label, never on completion meters.
integration.noExpansion: No new districts, currencies, progression system, combat or unrelated building changes are part of this milestone.

validationBoundary: This ledger is implemented design data only. Source references were inspected; integrated behavior, accessibility and provider acceptance remain with root. Faction-specific work mechanics are not implemented.
